description:
We are looking for Mainframe Developer in Raleigh, NC for 12+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job details mentioned below- 
 Title: Mainframe Developer 
 Location: Anderson Building 695 Palmer Drive Raleigh, NC 27603 
 Duration: 12+ Months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 
 
 

 Required skills: 

• DB2 (Z/OS) application Programming including knowledge of DB2 SQLs
• CICS application Programming
• Mainframe technologies (Cobol, CICS, JCL, DB2, Zeke, X/PTR)
• Experience with structured system development methodologies, preferably waterfall method
• Experience with COBOL debugging tools like XPEDITOR/CA-Intertest
• Candidates local to the Raleigh / Triangle Area
• Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational and time management skills
• Ability to translate and communicate highly technical concepts to both technical and non-IT business users
• Ability to develop relationships/partnerships with clients
• Extensive experience conducting problem analysis and issue resolution

 Desired Skills: 

• Experience performing business requirements definition, reviewing functional specifications, developing test cases, and performing unit testing
• Excellent written skills including experience using Microsoft Office tools (Word and Excel)
• Experience with QMF, SPUFI and FILEAID/CA-RC-Browse

 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
